notes.title: Thanks for all the support!
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on the mac release, coming soon. As this was my first game i didn't think i'd receive this much support. Thank you to the community for believing in me as a game dev and allowing me to continue my passion. You guys are awesome ^^

I hope you enjoy JumpFist, i'll be updating anything and everything as quickly as possible so please keep posting any bugs and lets make a great game together.

Until next time, get that parkour!!!
